reference.source: package/dist/antd.min.js; runtime CSS-in-JS; React 18.3.1; inherited global-token typography and color
reference.operation: Render legacy Panel and items precedence, headerClass/HTML attrs/callback refs, camelCase/capture/bubble/focus/key/mouse traces, direct public items, numeric/index keys, scalar/array/rich content, sizes/variants, ten tokens/aliases/algorithm, semantic callbacks and item precedence, ConfigProvider nesting/icons, local prefix and attributes. Compare computed slot CSS and content.
reference.nativeBoundary: Legacy children render directly without React child cloning. Without explicit keys the initial constructor index counts Panel instances only; dynamic implicit indexes/mixed DOM order are a Snippet boundary. Callback refs use native Svelte post-DOM effects and null cleanup; no React RefObject or synthetic event normalization. Preserve group/heading/button/regions, ARIA links, full button hit area, extra independence, keyed focus recovery, icon-mode fallback, default CSS palette and hidden native lifecycle. Header metrics use logical native trigger against upstream header, excluding DOM roles/tabstops, automatic IDs, native arrow SVG/rotation and native icon height.
reference.scope: Current public APIs only. Five semantic callback profiles recaptured with explicit componentSize=medium; other retained raw source measurements are unchanged.
